[G] DiagramService
+-- Public boundary: sole diagram content writer
|   +-- create / revise / generate -> DiagramRevisionResult
|   `-- getRevision / listRevisions -> records / frozen summaries
+-- create(input) -> DiagramRevisionEditor.prepareCreate -> issue
+-- revise(baseRevisionId, edit)
|   +-- getRevision -> editor.prepareEdit; unchanged -> reuse base
|   `-- changed -> keep diagramId; new revisionId -> issue(base)
+-- issue: registers revision in internal diagramRevisions
|   +-- record: id / diagramId / parentId? / diagram / nodeRefs
|   `-- node correspondence + base refs -> reuse refs or mint IDs
`-- generate(request, options) -> optional DiagramGenerator
    +-- request: input + instruction + agentContext? + selection context?
    +-- checks abort and base diagram; clones request -> generator.generate
    +-- generated input -> revise(replace) or create(revision: 0)
    `-- durable adapters flush issued records before publishing canvases
